verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll documents exporting customizable payroll reports and offers a first-party Workforce GraphQL API with payslip workflows and webhooks that fire when a connected company runs payroll. An agent could plausibly retrieve payroll data this way, but the evidence never describes payroll journal entries or reconciling them into a ledger. Missing for 10: documented payroll journal/GL entry data via API or export, a reconciliation workflow into the ledger, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven retrieval.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent pull payroll journal data via API or export and reconcile the entries into my ledger

citations.quote: You can customize, run, print, or export a payroll report and share valuable insights with your accountant.
Build payroll tools with the QuickBooks Workforce API -- schema, GraphQL, OAuth, webhooks, samples, and publishing.
A common use case for integrating with the QuickBooks Workforce API is to stay informed whenever a connected company runs payroll
